name: [🔮] My Magic Staff Farm
desc:
✨ Magical Staff Farm Tycoon 🔮

Open chests, collect rare staffs, and become the richest wizard on Roblox! Place your staffs to earn cash, boost your luck for rarer drops — then grab a battle staff and fight other wizards in the PvP arena! ⚔️

🎮 How to Play:

📦 Open chests & collect magical staffs
👷 Place staffs to earn money
🍀 Boost your luck for rarer staffs
⚔️ Battle players in the PvP arena
🏆 Climb the leaderboards for rewards

🌟 Goal: Collect the best staffs, dominate the arena, and become a true magical tycoon!
